sections.title: Naming an activity
sections.content: You already know szeretek + infinitive from A1 (szeretek sportolni). This lesson adds five new hobby verbs and their infinitives, so you can talk about specific things people do in their free time: gyűjt (collect), fest (paint), rajzol (draw), kertészkedik (garden), and fényképez (photograph).

items.spanish: Nem szeretek kertészkedni, de a férjem igen.
items.english: I don't like gardening, but my husband does.

sections.content: gyűjt ends in two consonants (-jt), so its infinitive needs a linking vowel before -ni: gyűjt + eni, not gyűjtni. kertészkedik works differently — it's an -ik verb, and the -ik simply drops before -ni: kertészked(ik) + ni.
